snippet.title: Hanjaro
snippet.description: Hi I'm Hanjaro - The bald is beautiful, bearded wonder, High Elo League of Legends Support Main! I stream daily on [ facebook.gg/hanjaro ] and answer any/most questions that are asked by viewers regarding the support role. I also offer coaching for those interested and upload the full reviews on Youtube so you can watch back the footage and take notes if necessary.
